kmeans.rule: Sprint 3 centroid rule (secondary similarity >= P25 own-centroid similarity AND gap <= P10 gap)

bertopic.rule: Sprint 3 centroid rule AND HDBSCAN soft membership of the secondary topic >= P75 of non-primary soft memberships; outliers assigned post hoc only by the Sprint 3 outlier rule

leiden.rule: Sprint 3 centroid rule AND edge-weight share to the secondary community >= P75 of positive non-own community shares

gmm.rule: secondary = 2nd-highest posterior iff p2 >= max(P90 of p2, numerical floor) AND p1 - p2 <= P10 of (p1 - p2)
